sources.snippet: License: Apache 2.0 | Authors: Google DeepMind DiffusionGemma is a generative model built by Google DeepMind. Based on the 26B A4B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Gemma 4 architecture, DiffusionGemma generates tokens using discrete diffusion. This open-weights model is multimodal, handling text, image, and video inputs to generate text output.
